captions.caption: Soldiers on a boat approach a semi-submersible in rough seas.
A soldier jumps from the boat onto the moving semi-submersible.
The soldier balances on the hull as waves crash over it.
Another soldier prepares to board the vessel amidst heavy splashing.
A soldier moves toward the front of the semi-submersible vessel.
Waves wash over the soldiers as they secure their footing.
The soldiers grip the hull to avoid being swept away.
Water spray obscures the camera as the chase continues at speed.
A soldier reaches for the hatch on top of the vessel.
The team works together to stay on the narrow deck.
A soldier bangs on the hatch of the semi-submersible.
The hatch is pried open by one of the boarding soldiers.
Soldiers look into the vessel through the opened hatchway.
The hatch cover is fully lifted by the soldiers.
A person inside the vessel puts their hands up.
Soldiers command the occupants of the vessel to surrender.
The boarding team secures the hatch and the occupants.
Video transitions to a wide shot of the chase boat.
The chase boat speeds through choppy water under gray skies.
A soldier on the chase boat shouts at the semi-submersible.
The semi-submersible is seen cutting through large ocean swells.
The chase boat maintains a close distance to the target.
Waves splash against the hull of the interceptor boat.
A soldier points toward the target vessel ahead of them.
The chase boat accelerates to catch up with the semi-submersible.
The target vessel is partially submerged while moving at high speed.
Sea spray is thrown up as the chase boat maneuvers.
The semi-submersible is visible in the distance among the waves.
The interceptor boat bounces over heavy swells in the ocean.
A soldier continues to signal and shout at the target.
The chase boat pulls alongside the moving semi-submersible.
Large splashes of water hit the camera on the boat.
The target vessel's exhaust stacks are visible above the waterline.
The chase boat matches the speed of the semi-submersible.
The semi-submersible disappears briefly behind a large wave.
The chase boat pilot steers carefully through the rough sea.
The target vessel continues its path through the choppy waters.
A soldier on the boat stays focused on the semi-submersible.
The chase boat's bow hits the water, creating a large spray.
The semi-submersible is framed against a cloudy, bright horizon.
The interceptor boat maneuvers to get closer for boarding.
Water continues to spray over the boat and the crew.
The target vessel moves steadily through the high-seas swells.
The chase boat maintains a parallel course with the target.
Another support boat is seen in the distance during the chase.
A soldier on the boat prepares to jump onto the target.
The semi-submersible is battered by waves as it speeds along.
The camera captures the rapid movement of the ocean surface.
The chase boat pilot adjusts the engine speed for the intercept.
The semi-submersible's hull is visible just above the water level.
The interceptor boat gets very close to the target vessel.
Waves crash between the two moving vessels in the sea.
The chase boat's crew readies themselves for the final approach.
The semi-submersible continues its attempt to evade the boats.
A soldier braces himself on the side of the chase boat.
The target vessel is hit by a large wave from the side.
The chase boat moves in for the boarding maneuver.
A soldier leaps from the boat onto the semi-submersible.
The soldier lands on the hull and begins to move forward.
The boarding team takes control of the semi-submersible's deck.
